about: Scene parts for the anime chill landscape of each video. A scene is one place + one time + one weather + one detail; no combination is ever used twice, and the place differs from the last `cover.scene_place_gap` videos. `text` goes into m10-mixcover's prompt (English, no people); `label` is what the human reads. Words m10-mixcover blocks (child, kid, teen, minor...) must never appear here.
